intro: Reference for the Python you write in nodes and operators. Import types with: from proxy.api import RequestContext

groups.title: Entry points
groups.summary: The functions you implement. Their names are fixed.

entries.name: run(input, context, params)
entries.summary: Custom node body. Whatever you return becomes the next step's input.

entries.name: triggered_by(context)
entries.summary: Start node. Return True to run this policy for the request, False to skip it.

entries.name: if_condition(input)
entries.summary: If operator. True takes the then branch, False the else branch.

entries.name: switch_condition(input)
entries.summary: Switch operator. Return a case label to choose the matching output port.

groups.title: RequestContext
groups.summary: The context argument. The live state for one request.

entries.name: context.flow
entries.summary: The intercepted request/response (mitmproxy flow).

entries.name: context.config
entries.summary: The active proxy configuration (modes, policies, nodes).

entries.name: context.state
entries.summary: Persistent per-platform usage store on disk.

entries.name: context.event_log
entries.summary: Append-only JSONL event log.

entries.name: context.data
entries.summary: Mutable scratch dict. Not merged between steps automatically.

entries.name: context.now()
entries.summary: Current UNIX time in seconds (UTC).

entries.name: context.request_id
entries.summary: Unique id for this request evaluation.

entries.name: context.log
entries.summary: Structured logger that writes filterable events.

groups.title: Flow & request
groups.summary: Read and change the HTTP request through context.flow.

entries.name: flow.request
entries.summary: The HTTP request object.

entries.name: flow.response
entries.summary: Assign a response to block or short-circuit the request.

entries.name: request.method
entries.summary: HTTP method, e.g. GET or POST.

entries.name: request.pretty_host
entries.summary: Request host, e.g. www.youtube.com.

entries.name: request.pretty_url
entries.summary: Full reconstructed URL.

entries.name: request.path
entries.summary: Path and query string.

entries.name: request.headers
entries.summary: Case-insensitive header map. Use .get(name, default).

entries.name: request.url
entries.summary: Settable URL; assign to redirect the request.

groups.title: State store
groups.summary: Track time per platform across requests (context.state).

entries.name: state.track_usage(platform, idle_seconds, now)
entries.summary: Add active time for a platform; returns the updated usage record.

entries.name: state.usage_today(platform, now)
entries.summary: Seconds used today (UTC) for a platform.

entries.name: event_log.append(event)
entries.summary: Append one JSON event dict to the log.

entries.name: log.info(message, **data)
entries.summary: Log an info event with optional structured data.

entries.name: log.debug(message, **data)
entries.summary: Log a debug event.

entries.name: log.warning(message, **data)
entries.summary: Log a warning event.

entries.name: log.error(message, **data)
entries.summary: Log an error event.

entries.name: log.event(type, message, level, **data)
entries.summary: Log a custom event type at the given level.

groups.title: Params
groups.summary: Values configured on the step in the UI.

entries.name: params[key]
entries.summary: Read a configured parameter. Missing keys raise KeyError.
